screenshots.name: 01-initial-board.png
screenshots.note: Fresh board, puzzle 1 (Warm-up), 16 shuffled tiles, mistakes full, picker visible.

screenshots.name: 02-four-selected.png
screenshots.note: Four tiles selected (dark) before submitting the first group: SHADES OF RED.

screenshots.name: 03-first-group-solved.png
screenshots.note: First group locked into a colored solved row; feedback confirms it.

screenshots.name: 04-wrong-guess.png
screenshots.note: A wrong guess: one mistake dot depleted, red "Not a group" feedback after the shake.

screenshots.name: 05-win.png
screenshots.note: Win state: all four groups revealed as colored rows, "Solved it!" verdict, end controls.

screenshots.name: 06-share-output.png
screenshots.note: Copy-results output: emoji result grid (clipboard or manual-copy fallback under http).

screenshots.name: 07-picker-jump.png
screenshots.note: Jumped to puzzle 3 via the picker board; chip 1 shows green (won), chip 3 dark (current).

screenshots.name: 08-loss-reveal.png
screenshots.note: Loss state: out of guesses, every remaining group auto-revealed, "Out of guesses" verdict.

screenshots.name: 09-picker-mixed.png
screenshots.note: Picker board with mixed session statuses: green won, blue lost, dark current, grey unplayed.

screenshots.name: 10-underfilled-warn.png
screenshots.note: Submitting with fewer than four selected shows a clear warning, no crash.

screenshots.name: 11-mobile-375.png
screenshots.note: Mobile viewport (375px): layout reflows, chips regrid to 5 columns, tiles stay tappable.
